Subject: Quick intro + Dedicated capacity walkthrough?

Hi Priya —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood and filling out the quick intake — I saw EdgeBank’s profile and the notes about high-concurrency inference for AML scoring. I’d love to set up a short walkthrough to cover how our Dedicated offering handles throughput, latency SLOs, and a simple test plan you can run during POC.

A few quick asks so we tailor the session:
- Typical peak concurrent requests per second (RPS) and p95 latency target (ms)
- Preferred time window for a 30–45 minute walkthrough (we can include an engineer if you want a deeper dive)
- Any non-negotiable security controls (VPC, KMS, audit logs) you want us to cover

Proposed windows (UTC):
- Tue Jul 13, 09:00–09:45
- Tue Jul 13, 15:00–15:45
- Wed Jul 14, 10:00–10:45

You can also pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/hannah/30

I’ve attached our Dedicated playbook for a quick read. If you can send the throughput spreadsheet (or I can send a template), that’ll help us pre-size the environment.

Looking forward —
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
SDR, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@edgebank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Quick intro + Dedicated capacity walkthrough?

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. We completed the self-serve signup last week. Brief answers below:
- Peak concurrent RPS: ~180–250 (batching at the client side sometimes)
- p95 latency target: <= 120ms for in-path scoring; offline batch can be higher
- Security: VPC peering and customer KMS mandatory; SOC2 evidence would be helpful

Preferred times: Tue Jul 13 morning CET or Wed Jul 14 morning CET. I attached a spreadsheet with more details (throughput by endpoint).

One more thing — we’re evaluating two vendors in parallel; timeline is tight (decision by end of month). Happy to have an engineer join if it helps answer the latency questions.

Best,
Priya
